moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 EFL Championship season begins on Friday, August 14th, with a full weekend of fixtures including Wrexham's return to the second tier.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: The whistle's about to blow! The EFL Championship season kicks off this Friday, August 14th. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Wrexham's Big Return
angles.copy: Wrexham are back in the Championship! Their campaign starts Monday, August 17th against Cardiff City. Huge week for Welsh football!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Week
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in its final week, with the Eliminator on August 14th and the Grand Final on August 16th, culminating in Lord's.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Week in The Hundred! Who's making it to Lord's for the big final on Sunday? Every match counts!

angles.name: Welsh Fire in Action
angles.copy: Welsh Fire are burning bright in The Hundred! Don't miss their last push for glory with matches happening today and the Eliminator on Friday.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Season Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The Community Shield is this Sunday! Arsenal v Man City in Cardiff. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the Community Shield this Sunday! The Principality Stadium is ready for Arsenal and Man City. Get ready for a massive day of football!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing throughout August, featuring thousands of comedy, theatre, music, and dance performances.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the Fringe! Comedy, theatre, music, dance – what hidden gems have you discovered or are you planning to see?

angles.name: Arts Extravaganza
angles.copy: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is serving up a smorgasbord of talent all month. Dive into the world's biggest arts festival!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, Wales' largest music, arts, and science festival, takes place in the Brecon Beacons from August 20-23, featuring acts like Mogwai and Wilco, with tickets already sold out.

angles.name: Green Man Excitement
angles.copy: It's almost time for Green Man! The Brecon Beacons will be buzzing with music and arts from August 20-23. Who's heading to Wales' biggest festival?

angles.name: Sold Out Vibes
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is sold out and just days away! Get ready for Mogwai, Wilco and more in the stunning Welsh mountains.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean remain at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart this week (August 7-13) with 'Rein Me In' for a remarkable 20th week, while new entries from Ariana Grande shake up the Top 10.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make it 20 weeks at the top with 'Rein Me In'. Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: Ariana's Chart Impact
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is making waves on the Official Singles Chart with new entries! Which of her tracks is your favourite right now?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Buzz
moments.blurb: Anticipation is building for the 17th series of The Great British Bake Off, expected to return to Channel 4 on September 2nd, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

source.l: Radio Times / The Cake & Bake Show

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Get your ovens ready! The Great British Bake Off returns September 2nd. Who's excited for new bakers and fresh bakes?

angles.name: Nigella Joins Bake Off
angles.copy: Big news in the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson is the new judge alongside Paul Hollywood. What do you think of the new addition?

moments.title: Premier League Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal defending their title and newly promoted Coventry City, Hull City, and Ipswich Town joining the top flight.

source.l: Premier League Official / DAZN News GB

angles.name: New Season Hype
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns on Friday, August 21st. Who's your pick for champions this season?

angles.name: Promoted Teams Ready
angles.copy: Welcome back to the big time! Coventry City, Hull City, and Ipswich Town are ready for their Premier League challenge starting August 21st.

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest electronic music festivals, Creamfields, is set to take place from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring a massive lineup of DJs and live acts.

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: Creamfields is just around the corner! Get ready for four days of non-stop electronic music from August 27-30. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The UK's biggest dance festival is almost here! Creamfields takes over Daresbury from August 27th. The countdown is on!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaches
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer holidays for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Dreaming of that extra day off? The August Bank Holiday is just over two weeks away! What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: End of Summer Break
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday on the 31st signals the end of summer for many. Make the most of it, Devon! Where's your favourite spot for a long weekend?
